seam_notes: The technique's precondition held exactly: every span carries the event id that get_event reads, so input/output are recoverable by a tool call the model can still make - elision, not compaction, is the correct instrument. A null payload is left null rather than replaced: there is nothing to fetch back, and a marker there would claim material exists. The project had already SPECIFIED this in docs/harness/perf-feature-2026-07-16/mcp-resources-error-mapping.perf.md:16, including the marker wording; it was never implemented, and resources.rs had no cap of any kind. Deliberately not touched: the Markdown content item (the primary view, and the reason the JSON item can afford to be terse), the span count, and the render layer.
